def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter, deque

    bg = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen = set()
    comps = []

    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == bg or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            color = grid[r][c]
            q = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for yy, xx in ((y-1, x), (y+1, x), (y, x-1), (y, x+1)):
                    if (0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and
                        (yy, xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx] == color):
                        seen.add((yy, xx))
                        q.append((yy, xx))
            comps.append((color, cells))

    # The long, thin component is the color-bar/line that supplies the new color.
    bars = []
    for color, cells in comps:
        rs = [r for r, c in cells]
        cs = [c for r, c in cells]
        height, width = max(rs)-min(rs)+1, max(cs)-min(cs)+1
        span = max(height, width)
        density = len(cells) / (height * width)
        if span >= 5 and density <= 0.65:
            bars.append((span, len(cells), color, cells))
    if not bars:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    _, _, donor_color, bar = max(bars)

    # Locate the elbow of an L-shaped bar.
    corner = None
    for r, c in bar:
        row_count = sum(1 for y, x in bar if y == r)
        col_count = sum(1 for y, x in bar if x == c)
        if row_count >= 2 and col_count >= 2:
            corner = (r, c)
            break

    if corner is not None:
        r0, c0 = corner
        horizontal = [c for r, c in bar if r == r0]
        vertical = [r for r, c in bar if c == c0]
        # Choose the side opposite each arm of the elbow.
        dc = -1 if max(horizontal) > c0 else 1
        dr = -1 if max(vertical) > r0 else 1
        # If arms extend both ways, use their longer side.
        if min(horizontal) < c0 and max(horizontal) > c0:
            dc = -1 if c0 - min(horizontal) > max(horizontal) - c0 else 1
        if min(vertical) < r0 and max(vertical) > r0:
            dr = -1 if r0 - min(vertical) > max(vertical) - r0 else 1
    else:
        # For a straight bar, look away from its midpoint.
        rs = [r for r, c in bar]
        cs = [c for r, c in bar]
        r0, c0 = sum(rs)/len(rs), sum(cs)/len(cs)
        dr = 1 if r0 < h/2 else -1
        dc = 1 if c0 < w/2 else -1

    # Recolor the nearest separate object in the quadrant opposite the bar.
    best = None
    for color, cells in comps:
        if color == donor_color:
            continue
        eligible = [(r, c) for r, c in cells
                    if (r-r0)*dr > 0 and (c-c0)*dc > 0]
        if not eligible:
            continue
        dist = min(abs(r-r0) + abs(c-c0) for r, c in eligible)
        if best is None or dist < best[0]:
            best = (dist, cells)

    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    if best is not None:
        for r, c in best[1]:
            out[r][c] = donor_color
    return out

        if min(row_cs) < c0 < max(row_cs):
            dc = -1 if c0 - min(row_cs) > max(row_cs) - c0 else 1
        if min(col_rs) < r0 < max(col_rs):
            dr = -1 if r0 - min(col_rs) > max(col_rs) - r0 else 1
    else:
        return out

    # Recolor the nearest component in that quadrant.

        eligible = [(r, c) for r, c in cells

        if best is None or distance < best[0]:
